name: sourceType
label: Source definition
description: Switch between different source definition types

name: scorecardType
label: Scorecard Type
description: Switch between different scorecard types

name: indicatorGroup
label: Indicator group
description: Filter the table based on a indicator group from the list.

name: indicators
label: Indicators
description: List of indicators

name: breakdowns
label: Breakdowns And Elements
description: Json object with Breakdowns and Elements

name: aggregateId
label: Time series aggregations
description: Time series aggregations

name: showBreakdownsOnly
label: Show only breakdowns
description: Hide indicator total and show only breakdowns

name: allowChangeBreakdown
label: Allow change breakdown
description: Allow user switch breakdown during consumption

name: breakdownVisibilitySelector
label: Selector visible by default
description: When enabled the group by selector is visible on the data visualization. Otherwise, Change Breakdown is available under the More options menu.

name: showBookmarkedOnly
label: Show Bookmarked Items Only
description: Show only bookmarked indicators

name: swapBreakdownsAsColumns
label: Show breakdown elements as columns
description: Show breakdowns elements as columns

name: nestedBreakdown
label: Nest Breakdown
description: Enable / Disable nested breakdowns

name: metrics
label: Metrics
description: Select metrics from the list to display as columns

name: query
label: Filter
description: Encoded query string to filter results by.

name: pageSize
label: Max elements per page
description: Maximum number of indicator/breakdown elements to be displayed in the list. Setting is applied only to the first level of elements that is used as row.

name: sortBy
label: Sort by
description: Sort by indicator group / metrics

name: sortDir
label: Sort direction
description: Sort direction to order the results

name: followFilters
label: Follow filters
description: Enable to filter the scorecards

name: showFilterElement
label: Show filter element
description: Show the applied filter element(s) together with the Indicator name. If a filter cannot apply to a visualisation, the element(s) do not show. Toggle off to hide the filter element(s) applied.

name: showFavorite
label: Show bookmark
description: Toggle to add or remove bookmark.

name: showIndicatorInfo
label: Show indicator info
description: Toggle to show or hide indicator info

name: showAlternateRowColors
label: Show alternative row colors
description: Toggle on to display background color for alternating rows. This can make reading the table data easier.

name: showRowDividers
label: Show row lines
description: Displays border row lines to show separate rows.

name: showColumnDividers
label: Show column lines
description: Displays border column lines to show separate columns.

name: showHeader
label: Show Header
description: Switch the toggle bar to show or hide header with all header elements (title, description, filter icons)

name: headingLevel
label: Heading level
description: HTML heading tag level of the header title (H1 to H6).

name: headingVariant
label: Use large font size
description: Defines the styles used to render the header title

name: showHeaderSeparator
label: Show header separator
description: Displays a line separating the header from the rest of the component.

name: heading
label: Title
description: Fill in the title that the end user sees.

name: description
label: Description
description: Fill in a short overview of the visualization that the end user sees.

name: lineClamp
label: Line of truncation
description: The number of lines the header can use before it’s truncated. Long headers will be cut off with an ellipsis after the selected number of lines.

name: headerTitleAlignment
label: Title alignment
description: Title alignment in horizontal direction

name: wrapTitle
label: Wrap title
description: Wraps long titles onto a second line. If false, displays an ellipses to truncate long title.

name: showBorder
label: Show border
description: Displays a line around the component.

name: filterConfigurations
label: Filter config
description: Unified filters configuration

name: colorSchemeId
label: Target color scheme
description: Select a target color scheme. By default, the value defined on the Performance Analytics Properties page is applied.

name: enableDrilldown
label: Enable drilldown
description: Redirects user to underlying data when they click a data point. Toggle off to prevent this interaction.

name: showFilterIcon
label: Show filter icon
description: Show the filter icon and the number of filters impacting the visualization. If a filter is not selected to apply to a visualization, the icon does not show. Toggle off to hide the filter icon and number of filters applied.

name: refreshRequest
label: Refresh requested
description: A string that can be passed down to trigger a data refresh. Refresh will be triggered only if the new value of this property is different from the previous one.

name: useDataCache
label: Use data cache
description: Original load of data visualization will use visualization cache data when available to ensure better performance. User can get current data on demand by using "Refresh button".

name: cacheExpirationTime
label: Cache expiration time (h)
description: Setting defines the time that cache will be valid. If existing cache is older than specified time the new query will be used instead and new cache created.

name: pageId
label: Page ID
description: It will accept an ID from the parent component and can be used to hold either a dashboard ID or a page ID. However, it is primarily used for holding the dashboard ID, which serves as an additional key for caching purposes.

name: showCacheTime
label: Show cache time
description: Show icon indication on the data visualization when returned data are from cache. On hover of the icon user can see how old are the data.
